========================================================================================
Exact decimal Phi (decimal.Decimal) — no binary float in the chain
========================================================================================
  getcontext().prec = 220   compare first 156 frac digits
  p digits ~ 78   p^2 digits ~ 155
  Build Phi from Decimal(int) / digit strings — never from float.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
0) Why not float / Decimal(float)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Decimal(0.1)+Decimal(0.2) = 0.3000000000000000166533453693773481063544750213623046875
  Decimal('0.1')+Decimal('0.2') = 0.3

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1) Phi(nG): Decimal vs Fraction vs float
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  n=1..64: Decimal Phi digit-match Fraction:     64/64
  n=1..64: T_neg from ints digit-match Fraction: 64/64
  n=1..64: C+(p-2y)/p^2 digit-match T_neg:       64/64
  n=1..64: float(Phi)!=float(Phi(-P)):           0/64
  float collapses negation (0/64). Decimal keeps the Fine-layer gap.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3) Forward orbit chain (ints -> Decimal encode each step)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  orbit + residual digit-match Fraction: True
  Pattern: mutate (x,y) in Z/pZ, then phi_decimal(x,y) — never float.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4) Policy
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • EC / F / psi: integer mod p (exact)
  • Algebraic Phi identities: Fraction (exact, unlimited)
  • Paper decimal print / forward digits: Decimal from ints, prec>=220
  • Init: Decimal(int) or Decimal('0.digits') — never Decimal(float)
  • Compare Phi values by digit prefix, not float==
  • Round-trip decode: keep (x,y) or Fraction; truncated Decimal is display

========================================================================================
VERDICT
========================================================================================
  Decimal is correct for human-exact Phi digit chains.
  Rebuild from ints on each orbit step; residual (p-2y)/p^2 matches at 156 digits.
  float is unfit (hides negation). F stays integer EC.
